title: A stack satisfying the normalization hypotheses has an integral normalization whose formation commutes with smooth base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a stack satisfying the hypotheses of the preparation lemma has an integral morphism from its normalization which restricts, after any smooth morphism from a scheme, to the normalization of that scheme (author lemma at source lines 10235-10246, label lemma-normalization). The proof (source lines 10248-10304) chooses the prepared presentation, normalizes the presentation, verifies that the normalization is compatible with the groupoid and descends it, and identifies the smooth base change with the normalization of the test scheme (proof lines 10248-10303). The descent of the normalization through the groupoid is the substance. H3.
